intro.text: A memorable event is remembered for its emotions, not its cables. That is why we take care of every technical detail, from the stage layout to the very last microphone, with discretion and precision.

events.title: For every occasion
events.lead: Every event has its own rhythm. We tailor the technology, the look and the organisation to your moment.

e1.d: Ambient lighting for dinner, an LED wall for photos and videos, low fog for the first dance.

e2.d: Clear sound, lighting for the dance floor and a screen showing your memories.

e3.d: Set-ups for cultural and family celebrations, even with many guests and long programmes.

e4.d: Screens, projectors and sound for presentations, conferences and official receptions.

e5.d: Truss, beam lights, sound and control for DJs, artists and shows.

services.title: All the technology for your event, from one partner
services.lead: We supply, install and operate the entire set-up. One point of contact, from the first idea to the final applause.

s1.d: LED walls in various types and sizes, plus TVs and projectors for presentations and projection.
list: Modular LED walls in various formats

s2.d: From the warm glow of a dinner to the show on the dance floor, with various lighting systems and made-to-measure truss.

s3.d: Systems designed for each venue: from a microphone for the speeches to flown speakers for large spaces.
list: Speakers and subwoofers, flown if needed

s4.d: Complete DJ systems and DJ booth preparation, in harmony with the lighting and screens.
list: Coordination with lighting and LED wall

s5.d: We bring the moment live to the screens and share it with those who cannot be there.
list: Live feed on the LED walls

s6.d: The right effect at the right moment: the couple's entrance, cutting the cake, opening the show.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: How far in advance should we book?
As early as possible, especially for summer weekends and the WEF period. For smaller events a few weeks is often enough: get in touch and we will check availability.
Yes. We handle transport, set-up, testing and take-down. On-site support during the event is agreed together in the quote.
Can we show our own photos and videos on the screens?
Of course. Send us photos, videos or logos before the event: we prepare them and play them during the evening, alongside the live feed if you wish.
Throughout Switzerland and, on request, in Italy, Germany and France. For outdoor events we assess the venue, power supply and weather protection together.
Can cold sparks and fog be used indoors?
In most venues, yes: cold sparks work without an open flame and we use professional equipment only. We always check the venue's rules and smoke detectors in advance.
